theorems.name: Submission.bf_sphereCap_lower_comparison
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (H : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), finrank ℝ H = n + 1 → ∀ ζ ∈ H, ‖ζ‖ = 1 → ∃ T : Submodule ℝ (Rn N), finrank ℝ T = n ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ 2 → μHE[n] ((T : Set (Rn N)) ∩ Metric.ball 0 (ρ / 2)) ≤ μHE[n] ({θ | θ ∈ H ∧ ‖θ‖ = 1} ∩ Metric.ball ζ ρ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
